subject: Ferry delay complaint
body: Hi, the 8:00 sailing was delayed again. I missed my appointment. Please explain what happened and how you will prevent this going forward.

subject: Incident report - minor vehicle damage
body: During loading, a vehicle mirror was damaged. No injuries. Please log the incident, notify terminal supervisor, and confirm procedures were followed.

subject: HVAC issue on Vessel A
body: We observed intermittent HVAC faults in passenger deck zones 2 and 3. Request inspection and prioritize before long weekend. Parts may be required.

subject: Lost item on board
body: I left my backpack on board yesterday. Can you confirm if it has been found and how I can retrieve it? It contains my laptop.

subject: Weekly asset note
body: Noticed higher-than-usual vibration readings on ramp system. Recommend review of sensor calibration and compare to last month's baseline.
